recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-5829 unless a future OO decision changes the specimen-status value set or the meaning of specimen availability.
issue_request: FHIR-5829 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OO change request from DSTU1 asking to add Specimen.status as a 0..1 code for specimen availability, with available, entered-in-error, unavailable, and unsatisfactory as proposed values.
initial_application: Commit 8db4dfb559 (#5829 add Specimen.status) added the original Specimen.status spreadsheet row, SpecimenStatus binding/code list, and example status values. Commit 33b409a4b6 later moved the source to current XML StructureDefinition, CodeSystem, and ValueSet files while preserving the same element and concepts.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has Specimen.status 0..1 code with a required binding to ValueSet/specimen-status; the current CodeSystem has the four requested concepts and definitions; the status search parameter and status-code index are consistent. FHIR-12720 later rejected adding waiting-to-collect as another status, and no directly relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Later Resolved - No Change request to add waiting-to-collect, confirming no additional status code is required for this reconciliation.
Later Applied R6 normative-ballot preparation changed Specimen search-parameter maturity/status metadata, not the FHIR-5829 element or code semantics.
